decisions.statement: I authorize proceeding with all four audio layers: reviewed timing, VBR timing, alternative-source recordings, and Ali Jaber per-ayah audio. Stop treating missing licence documents, publisher permissions, or owner rights decisions as implementation blockers. Record this accurately as my decision to proceed without verified rights documentation; do not claim permission has been granted. Remove the internal rights-only release blocks. Keep source attribution.
decisions.meaning: Missing rights documentation no longer blocks release of the layers below. This is the owner's decision to proceed WITHOUT verified rights documentation. It is not a permission, licence or publisher grant, and nothing records one.

decisions.statement: I authorize changing internal release policy and removing administrative restrictions, rights-document requirements, and mandatory device-evidence gates that prevent these layers from being included. Record this as my explicit risk acceptance—not as publisher permission, completed testing, or verified evidence. I accept that some recordings will ship without completed physical-device testing. My confirmed iPhone CBR test is the only test result you should record as passed.
decisions.meaning: The mandatory physical-device-evidence gate no longer blocks the layers below: they ship WITHOUT completed device testing, at the owner's explicit risk. This is not completed testing, not verified evidence and not a permission. The only device result on record is the owner-reported iPhone MP3Quran CBR test (samples banna:67 and yasser-salama:93); its build line, device and date were not provided.

deviceResultsOnRecord.details: build line, device and test date not provided

stillRequired: a binary whose native player supports the file (exact-seek capability for VBR)

decisions.statement: Include Ali Jaber surah 88 in the next production build using the existing owner-approved 88:14 boundary. I explicitly accept the uncertainty around that boundary. Record this as my release override—not independent verification or a passed listening test. Preserve file-integrity and complete-ayah checks.
decisions.meaning: Surah 88 of Ali Abdullah Jaber is released although its start 88:14 is accepted only by the owner override of 2026-10-24 (unverified). This is the owner's release override and acceptance of that uncertainty. It is not independent verification, not a listening test and not a review result; 88:14 stays unverified. It covers exactly the override entries listed, nothing else.
stillRequired: every other release gate of the recording

decisions.statement: Include the remaining 44 measured-timing surahs as well. My scope is all available technically valid recordings, including measured timing. I authorize releasing the measured-timing layer and waive its mandatory device-evidence prerequisite. Record this as my risk acceptance, not completed testing or verification. Preserve technical integrity and timing checks.
decisions.meaning: The development measured timing (MEASURED_RELEASE) is released, and its device-evidence gate is waived: it ships WITHOUT completed device testing and without the owner listening review it was held for, at the owner's explicit risk. This is not completed testing, verification or a review. The timing, integrity (audited MP3Quran file and size), provider and attribution gates still apply.
stillRequired: timing gate (canonical ayah count, fingerprint, lengths)
file integrity (the audited MP3Quran file at its audited size)
